title: AutoPass — auto end turn
description:
Automatically ends your turn the moment you have no possible actions left: no playable card in hand (energy, 0-cost, X-cost, star costs and card restrictions all respected via the game's own logic) and no potion you'd want to drink.

Configure it in the game's own Mods screen (select AutoPass in the mod list):
- Auto-end turn: on/off
- Potions block auto-pass: Always (default) / Elites & bosses only / Never

The default is conservative: any usable potion prevents auto-pass. Switch to 'Elites & bosses only' to auto-pass through hallway fights while you hoard potions (elite and boss fights still never end your turn while you hold one). Drink potions before playing your last card!

Multiplayer-safe: only ever presses YOUR end turn button, through the game's own code path. Marked as not affecting gameplay.

Source: https://github.com/bradfordseipp/sts2-autopass
changeNote: v0.1.1: Fixed a race with Unceasing Top / empty-hand triggers (auto-pass now waits for the action queue to be fully idle). Default potion mode is now 'Always block'; saved preferences unchanged.
